programme.title: Fight For Life with Tony Granato: Clint Malarchuk
programme.desc: Fight for Life with Tony Granato is a raw and deeply human docuseries that explores the untold stories of athletes who have faced life-altering trauma and found the courage to rise. Hosted by former NHL player and Olympic coach Tony Granato, who has his own powerful story of surviving brain surgery and cancer, the series delivers intimate, empathetic interviews with athletes who open up about the moments that nearly broke them.

programme.title: Fight For Life with Tony Granato: Craig Cunningham
programme.desc: Craig Cunningham's hockey career came to a sudden halt when he collapsed on the ice from cardiac arrest. Complications during his recovery led to the loss of his leg, forcing him to confront a future far different from the one he had always envisioned. In this episode of Fight for Life, Craig, his mother, and the doctorwho helped save his life reflect on the fight that changed everything.
